issues.description: The UML/specification in the problem statement declares the Animal attribute 'name' as type String, but the solution implementation stores the name as a private StringBuilder in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java. This deviates from the declared attribute type and could confuse students who expect the attribute to be a String and implement getters/setters accordingly.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution's Animal class store the name as a String to match the UML/specification: replace the private StringBuilder name field with private String name, update the constructor to assign the String directly, and update setName/getName to operate on String. Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to indicate the internal use of StringBuilder if that was intentional (not recommended).
